events.title: Stilicho executes the Gothic leader Radagaisus
events.description: Having trapped Radagaisus's invading army near Faesulae, the Roman general Stilicho had the Gothic king executed. Italy was saved for now, but Rome's frontiers were under mounting pressure.
events.html: Having trapped Radagaisus's invading army near Faesulae, the Roman general Stilicho had the Gothic king executed. Italy was saved for now, but Rome's frontiers were under mounting pressure.

events.title: William Wallace is executed in London
events.description: Betrayed and captured near Glasgow, William Wallace was hanged, drawn and quartered at Smithfield. The victor of Stirling Bridge became an enduring symbol of Scottish independence.
events.html: Betrayed and captured near Glasgow, William Wallace was hanged, drawn and quartered at Smithfield. The victor of Stirling Bridge became an enduring symbol of Scottish independence.

events.title: French court resolves to kill the Huguenot leaders
events.description: On the eve of St Bartholomew's Day, Charles IX and his council agreed to eliminate the Protestant leaders gathered in Paris. The killings began before dawn and spread across France.
events.html: On the eve of St Bartholomew's Day, Charles IX and his council agreed to eliminate the Protestant leaders gathered in Paris. The killings began before dawn and spread across France.

events.title: Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union sign a non-aggression pact
events.description: Ribbentrop and Molotov signed a pact in Moscow whose secret protocol divided eastern Europe into spheres of influence. It cleared the way for Germany's invasion of Poland a week later.
events.html: Ribbentrop and Molotov signed a pact in Moscow whose secret protocol divided eastern Europe into spheres of influence. It cleared the way for Germany's invasion of Poland a week later.

events.title: Two million people form the Baltic Way human chain
events.description: Some two million people joined hands across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania on the 50th anniversary of the Nazi-Soviet Pact. The 675 km chain demanded independence, regained in 1990-91.
events.html: Some two million people joined hands across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania on the 50th anniversary of the Nazi-Soviet Pact. The 675 km chain demanded independence, regained in 1990-91.
